subject.title: feat(dashboard): pinned MCP apps — board rendering, lease re-mint, durable tool grants

question: Should a revoked or replaced pinned MCP App lease retain any ability to update agent model context until its lease expires?
rationale: The feature’s stated grant model promises live rechecking per call, but deciding whether model-context writes are intentionally exempt is a security-boundary contract decision.

options.title: Recheck before every model-context update
options.body: Apply the widget authorization callback before `mcp.app.updateModelContext`, matching tool-call revocation semantics.

options.title: Allow context updates until lease expiry
options.body: Keep the current behavior only if maintainers explicitly accept that a revoked widget can affect the next agent turn during its remaining lease.

recommendation.title: Recheck before every model-context update
recommendation.body: Apply the widget authorization callback before `mcp.app.updateModelContext`, matching tool-call revocation semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This feature’s current implementation and grant model are concentrated in the branch commits authored by steipete.
